name: t3-clone
title: T3 Code clone
description: An IDE-style agent workspace in the style of T3 Code: thread sidebar, streaming conversation with a composer that flies from centre to dock, resizable terminal dock, a surface panel (browser, terminal, files, diff, agents), and a ⌘K command palette with nested pages (new thread in a project, link pull requests, go to file, search contents, add a project from a local folder, Git URL or GitHub) plus a live theme editor. Docks everything on desktop, slides the panel in as a drawer on tablets, and moves to a hamburger sidebar, bottom tab bar and snap-sheet terminal on phones. Composed from the WorkbenchShell, conversation, terminal and surface primitives, with its own thread sidebar parts.
